'''Tony Prokes''' (Anthony Prokes on the Decipher listing) was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 64 in the Corellia region, from Chicago, IL.<ref name="decsq-corellia" /><ref name="smlist" /> The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115090200/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/corellia.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
